notes.title: A new beginning
notes.notes:
Wanderers, it’s time to return to the backrooms for a new expedition featuring 8 revamped levels, and a complete overhaul of the game mechanics.


There is now crouching, doors, and more stuff.

Multiplayer is NOT GUARRANTEED TO WORK. IF IT DOESNT, SPECIFY WHAT IN THE DISCORD: https://discord.gg/KpkyvDj5cB


Improvements

Made crouching animations
Made game more optimized for lower-end hardware
NEW keybinds options
Audio options
And more..


Enjoy!

notes.title: Sorry.
notes.notes:
Hello there.. sorry for everyone who bought this and didn't get as much as they'd hope.

The game will update as soon as I get this new content done, i've already finished most of the new update.

With that said, for everyone who said it wasn't scary, not fun, or just too short, tell me, what should i improve? More levels? More optimization? Level expansions? I'd love to hear your thoughts.

(level 3 sneakpeek image.)
